_sources: Ports, the one param and the code: spec 005 (specs/005-first-models/spec.md).
The weights' file: pinned by spec 003's live run (specs/003-model-store/live/live.depth_pro), which spec 005's spike loaded on the owner's PC.

The memory model: spec 005's spike on an NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 (compute 6.1, 8 GB) on a 2880 x 1920 photo, read from torch's allocated memory and turned from MiB into MB. A first estimate every machine corrects (learned.json), never a choice made for that card; spec 005's local session fits it again with bench:fit.
fp16 on any card: torch runs half precision on every card its builds support; the spike ran it on compute 6.1 only.
Licences: from the README and LICENSE of apple/ml-depth-pro at 9e65e4d, the runtime's pin.
title: Depth Pro
summary: Apple's Depth Pro: sharp metric depth and the focal length from one photo, at a fixed 1536 px. Uses a known camera's focal length when one is connected.

camera.doc: Known intrinsics: its focal length is used instead of the estimate, and it is the camera handed on.

depth.doc: Metres along the camera's axis, at the photo's size.

camera.doc: The camera the depth was made with: its own focal estimate (source estimated), or the connected one's, at the photo's size.

weights.source: specs/005-first-models/reports/2026-11-03-spike.md: on the card once loaded, 3,636 and 1,826 MiB, on a GTX 1070 (compute 6.1)

working.source: specs/005-first-models/reports/2026-11-03-spike.md: the run's allocated peak less the weights, 5,161 MiB at fp32 and 3,176 at fp16, on a GTX 1070 (compute 6.1) and a 2880 x 1920 photo; a line through the two. The network runs at 1536 px whatever the photo's size

system_mb.source: the weights, which pass through system memory as they load (they are cast on the processor before a card); on a card, not measured yet: the spike could not read process memory on Windows (its finding 4), and spec 005's local session fits it with bench:fit. On a cloud session's processor, a whole run at fp32 peaked at 8,364 MB, under its estimate of 9,225 (specs/005-first-models/reports/2026-11-05-cloud-cpu.md)

cpu.source: specs/005-first-models/reports/2026-11-03-spike.md: import, load and first inference (7, 28 and 100 s) on an Intel Core i7-4770K, 4 cores

licence.weights: Apple's sample-code licence, the code's: its README releases the weights under the same LICENSE (Hugging Face's copy of them says apple-amlr)
